mechanism.summary: For a direct slot-seeded call whose received upvalues are statically read-only, retain one shared reference to the callee function and resolve the indexed cells from it instead of allocating a per-frame local-upvalue vector and cloning every cell handle.
mechanism.generality: Admission is determined solely from immutable bytecode and call-environment state: the function must already be eligible for the direct slot-seeded call path, have received upvalues, contain no write or clear of a received-upvalue slot, create no capturing closure, have no module-import or sloppy-global-fallback route, and have matching function upvalues. It does not inspect benchmark names, source paths, input sizes, values, iteration counts, function names, or workload-specific identities. All other calls keep the existing owned per-frame cell vector.
semantic_risks: preserving live shared-cell identity and observing every later binding update instead of caching a Value or pinning a former global binding
preserving realm binding deletion and accessor fallback when a realm-backed received cell holds the uninitialized lexical marker
keeping writes, clears, direct eval, with, module imports, sloppy global fallbacks, and capturing closures on the existing owned cell-vector path
preventing authoritative-slot classification from treating a borrowed received-upvalue slot as an uninitialized frame local
retaining normal frame construction and direct-call result behavior for direct function literals, constructors, and functions whose upvalue layout does not exactly match the compiled slots

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-29 target/performance-next-7d0f6bdb-r1/profiles/controlflow-recursive.sample; SHA-256 verified below. The 3,030-sample profile shows 2,694 samples through direct leaf calls, 393 at direct VM construction, and 55 at the received-upvalue local-load slow path. A same-source bytecode audit found ack, fib, and tak each have one received, read-only self cell. Runtime and CLI sources are identical to e66d0303 outside evidence-only commits.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Each recursive direct frame rebuilds local_upvalues for the read-only self cell, allocating the local-sized option vector and cloning the cell handle before LoadLocal reads that same live realm cell.

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-29 target/performance-next-7d0f6bdb-r1/profiles/hash-map.sample; SHA-256 verified below. The 1,299-sample profile shows 1,298 samples through direct leaf calls and 75 at direct VM construction. A same-source bytecode audit found the hot HashMap helpers and iterator methods receive read-only outer helper cells, including functions with 14 to 18 locals. Runtime and CLI sources are identical to e66d0303 outside evidence-only commits.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Read-only captured constructors and helpers currently force a local-sized option vector and one Rc clone per captured cell on every direct helper invocation even though the frame never writes or re-captures those bindings.

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-27 target/benchmarks/raytrace-public-class-fields.sample.txt; SHA-256 verified below. The 701-sample profile shows 699 samples through direct leaf calls and 28 at direct VM construction. A same-source bytecode audit found renderScene receives 11 read-only constructor/helper cells. The sampled runtime source is identical to e66d0303 in runtime and CLI paths.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: The direct renderScene frame owns no mutation of its 11 received cells, yet it rebuilds a local-upvalue vector and clones all of them per call before resolving the same live values.
